name: Nagasaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged with a red interlaced five-pointed star outline, its central pentagon bearing a small radiating emblem.
history: Nagasaki adopted its five-pointed-star emblem in 1900; the flag places it in red on a white field.

features.role: Nagasaki city emblem — an interlaced pentagram with central mark
features.symbolism: the five-pointed star, the city's emblem since 1900, is associated with the star shape of the port city's old fortifications and its opening to the West
